name: Robinhood Markets
verdict: Founder-controlled, Nasdaq-listed US company: co-founders Tenev and Bhatt hold 58.1% of voting power between them. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: main partner and shirt sponsor of OGC Nice's men's and women's first teams since 2025-26. Founder-controlled; the 5%+ Class A holders disclosed in the proxy are Vanguard and BlackRock, and no state or state fund appears among them, so proposed none.
